Bill.BriefDescription: Regarding assessment measures for meeting certificate of mastery standards.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to multiple measures of assessment to determinemeeting the standards for the certificate of mastery as a graduationrequirement; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.655 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.655RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The high school assessment system required under RCW 28A.655.060that leads to a certificate of mastery shall include multiple measuresof assessment to determine whether students have met the standards fora certificate of mastery. The superintendent of public instructionshall develop valid and reliable multiple measures, which may includebut not be limited to, the Washington assessment of student learning,a portfolio of evidence, high school grade point average, and academicand vocational evaluations. The superintendent of public instructionshall adopt these measures by rule not later than July 1, 2004.
